description: Adversarial and conformance vectors over inputs.json for openbody.whole-person-state/1.0. Input vectors mutate the golden envelopes (merge-patch or JSON-pointer set/unset) and reassemble; state vectors mutate snapshot.golden.json and re-validate. Vectors with target "state_with_inputs" mutate snapshot.golden.json and verify it against the input envelopes (decision 10); vectors with target "present_use" apply a current revocation set to the golden snapshot (decision 8).

vectors.name: determinism-input-order
vectors.covers: deterministic snapshot for the same admitted inputs

vectors.name: golden-entry-expectations
vectors.covers: epistemic statuses coexist without flattening; exact provenance

vectors.name: concordant-second-source
vectors.covers: no silent source-priority inference; independent sources carry their own record and record digest (decision 11)

vectors.name: device-claims-reported
vectors.covers: origin is orthogonal to epistemic status

vectors.name: import-claims-validation-without-receipt
vectors.covers: import or signature alone is not validation

vectors.name: clinical-record-without-link
vectors.covers: links to admitted observations, not copies

vectors.name: state-claims-clinical-assertion
vectors.covers: clinical assertions require the existing admission/model receipt path

vectors.name: identity-record-claimed-by-two-sources
vectors.covers: consumer source identity agreement: one source record, one source_id (no double-counted corroboration)

vectors.name: identity-record-revised-under-same-ref
vectors.covers: consumer source identity agreement: a revised record needs a version-specific record_ref

vectors.name: identity-correction-revokes-superseded-version
vectors.covers: revoked source record: a correction is a new version-specific record and the superseded version is revoked, never silently replaced

vectors.name: identity-code-in-two-domains
vectors.covers: no silent source-priority inference: one coded concept cannot be split across domains to avoid a conflict

vectors.name: state-admission-despite-blockers
vectors.covers: unknown uncertainty stays unknown: a blocked entry cannot be re-labelled as an admission candidate

vectors.name: state-blocker-dropped
vectors.covers: unknown uncertainty stays unknown: blockers cannot be dropped from a snapshot

vectors.name: state-input-unaccounted
vectors.covers: exact provenance survives state assembly: every input is a candidate or an exclusion

vectors.name: same-source-same-time-disagreement
vectors.covers: no silent source-priority inference: two records one source stamped at the same time are never tie-broken by id

vectors.name: same-source-same-time-agreement
vectors.covers: no silent source-priority inference: agreeing same-time records from one source stay single_source with both in the basis

vectors.name: value-set-presence-and-severity-separate
vectors.covers: decision 3: presence and severity are separate dimensions, neither equivalent nor contradictory

vectors.name: value-set-absent-and-severity-not-contradictory
vectors.covers: decision 3: a presence 'absent' is not compared with a severity

vectors.name: value-set-presence-disagreement-conflicts
vectors.covers: decision 3: within one dimension, disagreeing sources remain a conflict

vectors.name: value-set-unlisted-value-excluded
vectors.covers: decision 3: an unlisted categorical value is excluded, never guessed

vectors.name: value-set-case-sensitive
vectors.covers: decision 3: values are compared exactly, without case folding

vectors.name: value-set-unlisted-code-excluded
vectors.covers: decision 3: a categorical code without an OpenBody value set is excluded

vectors.name: value-set-code-requires-categorical
vectors.covers: decision 3: a value-set code carried as free text is excluded

vectors.name: state-dimension-relabelled
vectors.covers: decision 3: an entry's dimension must be what the value set gives its values

vectors.name: state-dimension-dropped
vectors.covers: decision 3: categorical values need a dimension

vectors.name: state-dimension-on-quantity
vectors.covers: decision 3: a code without a value set has no dimension

vectors.name: state-value-sets-pin-altered
vectors.covers: decision 3: a snapshot is only verified under the value sets it pins

vectors.name: validation-after-as-of-excluded
vectors.covers: decision 8: a validation receipt dated after as_of did not exist at as_of

vectors.name: validation-at-as-of-kept
vectors.covers: decision 8: a validation dated exactly at as_of counts

vectors.name: replay-earlier-as-of-before-validation
vectors.covers: decision 8: replay at an earlier as_of does not see a later validation

vectors.name: state-validation-after-as-of
vectors.covers: decision 8: validate_state rejects a candidate validated after as_of

vectors.name: present-use-no-new-revocation
vectors.covers: decision 8: a historical snapshot with no current revocation is usable

vectors.name: present-use-record-revoked-since-snapshot
vectors.covers: decision 8: a record revoked after as_of blocks present use, including derived candidates

vectors.name: present-use-consent-withdrawn-since-snapshot
vectors.covers: decision 8: consent withdrawn after as_of blocks present use

vectors.name: present-use-clinical-version-revoked-since-snapshot
vectors.covers: decision 8: a clinical version revoked after as_of blocks present use

vectors.name: present-use-binding-revoked-since-snapshot
vectors.covers: decision 8: a subject binding revoked after as_of blocks every candidate

vectors.name: placement-golden-verified-against-inputs
vectors.covers: decision 10: the golden snapshot is reproducible from its envelopes

vectors.name: placement-entry-code-relabelled
vectors.covers: decision 10: a candidate filed under another code is caught against its envelope

vectors.name: placement-entry-domain-relabelled
vectors.covers: decision 10: a candidate filed under another domain is caught against its envelope

vectors.name: placement-candidate-value-altered
vectors.covers: decision 10: a consistent but altered candidate differs from its envelope

vectors.name: placement-envelope-missing
vectors.covers: decision 10: every listed input needs its envelope

vectors.name: placement-envelope-substituted
vectors.covers: decision 10: a substituted envelope does not match the listed digest

vectors.name: placement-revocations-tampered
vectors.covers: decision 10: a snapshot that is not what its inputs assemble to is rejected

vectors.name: independence-shared-record-digest-not-corroboration
vectors.covers: decision 11: another emitter of the same underlying record (same record digest) is not independent corroboration

vectors.name: independence-mirror-plus-independent-source
vectors.covers: decision 11: a mirrored record counts once; a separate record from another source still corroborates

vectors.name: independence-same-record-second-connection
vectors.covers: decision 11: the same ProvidEHR record through another adapter or connection is not a second source

vectors.name: independence-disagreeing-mirror-is-conflict
vectors.covers: decision 11: a mirror that disagrees is still a conflict, never silently merged
